_comment: THE TABLE.  One record per GNOME generation whose private MetaMonitorsConfig
layout has been measured, and the only place a version-specific fact lives.
Adding a GNOME release is one record here, one record in GENERATIONS in
wxrandr/gnome_overlap.py (a test proves the two are identical, field for
field), and `python3 gnome/overlap-typelib/gen-gir.py`, which writes the .gir,
the .typelib and metadata.json's shell-version out of this file.  Then the
three-head measurement, which is the actual work.  The whole procedure is
docs/Technical.md section 6, 'Adding a GNOME generation'.
EVERY NAME IS WRITTEN OUT, none is computed from a number.  Through GNOME 50
libmutter's API version was a counter of its own -- 46 carried libmutter-14, 50
carried libmutter-18 -- and code that derived 'libmutter-<n>.so.0' from a single
small integer worked by accident of that arithmetic.  mutter 51 sets
libmutter_api_version to the GNOME major itself (meson.build line 10 of the
51~rc tarball), so the next Ubuntu's library is libmutter-51.so.0 with
Meta-51.typelib beside it and the arithmetic is gone.  A record therefore
spells out the soname, the typelib version and the namespace, and a generation
whose names follow no scheme at all is still one record.
shell_major   the GNOME Shell major version, as Config.PACKAGE_VERSION
and org.gnome.Shell's ShellVersion property report it
libmutter     the label this generation is called by, in messages and in
the recorded agreement.  A string, never arithmetic
soname        the file name of the libmutter that must be mapped into
gnome-shell, matched against /proc/self/maps
meta_typelib  the version GIRepository reports for the Meta namespace
namespace     the type description this project ships for it, under
typelib/<namespace>-1.0.typelib
struct_size   GObject.type_query(MetaMonitorsConfig).instance_size, as
measured on a running session of this generation.  The
extension re-reads it from the GType registry on every call
and refuses unless the two agree
tail_slots    4-byte slots between disabled_monitor_specs and layout_mode:
the whole of what differs between the descriptions.  It is
what gen-gir.py --from-header derives from a release's own
header
measured_on   where the numbers above were taken, so that a claim in this
file can be traced to a machine somebody ran it on

generations.measured_on: Fedora 43, GNOME Shell 49.9, mutter 49.7-1.fc43 (libmutter-17.so.0 build c7c9add6935d)
Ubuntu 26.10, GNOME Shell 51.beta, mutter 51~beta-1ubuntu2 (libmutter-51.so.0 build e13468162ed2)
